name: Power Brothers
caption: Jim and Terry Power, a combined 695 lbs, beat Damage, Inc. on the fed's own 12 December 1996 broadcast.

name: Damage, Inc.
caption: Crippler and Widowmaker, a combined 503 lbs, lose to the Power Brothers on the fed's own 12 December 1996 broadcast.

name: Flying Thunder
caption: Quasar and Legend X regain the IWF Television Tag Team Championship from the Brain Busters on 12 December 1996 with a moonsault off the top of a steel cage, becoming the promotion's first repeat champions.

name: Brain Busters
caption: Tony and Shawn, a combined 700 lbs, lose the IWF Television Tag Team Championship to Flying Thunder on 12 December 1996, having won the belts from them two weeks earlier.

name: The Apocalypse
caption: Ghost and Darkness, a combined 522 lbs, lose to the Outriders on 12 December 1996 after a chair shot from Terry.

name: The Outriders
caption: Arn and Terry, a combined 390 lbs, managed by Johnny Dangerous; beat the Apocalypse on 12 December 1996 after Terry blindsides Darkness with a chair.

name: Death & Destruction
caption: IWF US Tag Team Champions as of 13 February 1997; a non-title outing against Flying Thunder is previewed for that same night.

name: Assault & Battery
caption: Assault & Battery: a tag team in the Interuniversal Wrestling Federation, named on the federation's February 1997 title update.
